resolvedFindings.summary: Container-Dateisystem und Host-Mount-Grenze verwechselt / Container filesystem confused with host mount boundary
resolvedFindings.evidence: Current equivalent DE/EN text distinguishes exposed host directories, writable container layer, temporary paths, persistent volumes, stop versus removal and additional agent-specific Codex restrictions. Compared with compose.yml, Dockerfile and codex configuration; focused static regression passed.
resolvedFindings.followUp: Preserve corrected bilingual wording and focused regression; reopen on the trigger below. No further correction is required in this review.
resolvedFindings.reevaluationTrigger: Change to mounts, root filesystem/user permissions, temporary paths, agent filesystem policy or boundary wording.
resolvedFindings.originalEvidence: The English summary says the container cannot write to anything outside the listed mounts. Compose has no read_only root filesystem and the image uses a writable adedev home and temporary paths. The claim must be scoped to unmounted host directories, not all container paths; Codex filesystem restrictions are a separate layer.
